articles.title: Morgan Stanley MUFG upgrades Japan Focus List with AI and insurance plays
articles.summary: Investing.com -- Morgan Stanley MUFG Securities analyst Sho Nakazawa has revised the firm's Japan Focus List, adding two stocks while removing others to reduce concentration risk tied to artificial intelligence investment assumptions. The changes, effective November 13, come as the valuation gain/loss ratio of margin buyers fell to -21.08% on November 6, its lowest level since May 2020, suggesting widespread margin-call selling.
